newsitem.title: HONG KONG: K.Wah Const says in HK$100 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: K.Wah Const says in HK$100 mln placement.

text.p: K. Wah Construction Materials Ltd said on Friday its substantial shareholder Lui Che Woo had arranged to place 77 million shares, or 9.95 percent of the company's existing share capital, at HK$1.30 each.
The concrete pipes maker said the shares would be placed to private and institutional investors.
Lui's stake in the company will be reduced to 7.01 percent from 16.96 percent on completion of the deal, it said.
The company said there would not be any change in the board of directors, the principal business of the company or its day-to-day operations following the deal.
K. Wah shares were up HK$0.07 to HK$1.38 in morning trade.
